description.narrative: (Egypt): The goal of Business Egypt is to expand the quality and quantity of job opportunities, especially for women and youth, and to increase sales revenues and investment in the local market. The activity will support the establishment, growth, and competitiveness of productive and innovative startups and promising micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), creating a vibrant and high functioning ecosystem of competitive and innovative enabling institutions that accelerate economic development in Egypt. Specifically, this activity will: assist new and growing MSMEs, supporting dynamic and innovative firms and startups through business incubators and accelerators and supporting women- and youth-led businesses and networks; build value chain linkages between anchor firms (buyers) and MSMEs (suppliers) by developing and strengthening buyer-led (anchor firm) approaches to MSME development; and, enhance the business enabling environment for MSME growth by supporting efforts to simplify tax administration processes, reforming a few high priority regulatory challenges for businesses, and developing a new streamlined process for approving business operation licenses in one-stop shops.
